properties.title: checked_total adds without overflow
properties.natspec: checked_total returns the sum of a and b if it fits in a u64, and None otherwise.

properties.title: Shares never exceed the total
properties.natspec: A vault never has more shares than its total. reset is an exception: it leaves one share and a total of 0 to mark an emptied vault.

properties.title: double doubles
properties.natspec: double returns twice x, wrapping on overflow.

properties.title: mul_div divides the product
properties.natspec: If c is not 0 and a * b / c fits in a u64, mul_div returns a * b / c rounded down.
